sections.intent: Pre-empt the most common questions from prospective teams and fans to reduce support volume and build confidence in the registration process.
sections.headline: Questions from the Grid.
sections.subheadline: The answers you need before you hit send.

items.title: How many players does a team need to register?
items.description: Teams must register a minimum of 5 active players and up to 2 substitute players. All players must be 16 or older.

items.title: Is there an entry fee?
items.description: Neon Division entry is free. Void Division requires a $50 registration fee. Apex Division is invite-only based on Season 3 performance.

items.title: What games are included in Season 4?
items.description: Season 4 features three titles: Voidstrike (FPS), GridRacer (Racing), and Cipher Protocol (Tactical Strategy). Teams compete in one title per division.

items.title: Can I watch matches for free?
items.description: Yes. All matches are streamed free on NeonriftLive. Premium subscribers get access to multi-stream views, VODs, and stat overlays.

items.title: When does team registration close?
items.description: Late registration closes 72 hours before the first Group Stage match. Spots are first-come, first-served.
